question: Find the name and tier of all clients with overdue invoices.
sql: SELECT c.name, c.tier FROM clients c JOIN projects p ON c.client_id = p.client_id JOIN invoices i ON p.project_id = i.project_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue';

question: Show average project budget by client tier.
sql: SELECT c.tier, AVG(p.budget) AS avg_budget FROM clients c JOIN projects p ON c.client_id = p.client_id GROUP BY c.tier;

question: List top 5 employees by total hours logged on completed projects.
sql: SELECT e.name, SUM(tl.hours) AS total_hours FROM employees e JOIN time_logs tl ON e.employee_id = tl.employee_id JOIN projects p ON tl.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.status = 'completed' GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY total_hours DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Count total invoices and sum amount for paid invoices in 2026.
sql: SELECT COUNT(invoice_id) AS total_paid_invoices, SUM(amount) AS total_paid_amount FROM invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND invoice_date >= '2026-01-01' AND invoice_date <= '2026-12-31';

question: Show clients with total billing exceeding $50,000.
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount) AS total_billing FROM clients c JOIN projects p ON c.client_id = p.client_id JOIN invoices i ON p.project_id = i.project_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING SUM(i.amount) > 50000;

question: What is the average time spent on tasks by priority?
sql: SELECT t.priority, AVG(tl.hours) AS avg_hours FROM tasks t JOIN time_logs tl ON t.task_id = tl.task_id GROUP BY t.priority;

question: Find all projects with unpaid invoices and their primary client contact.
sql: SELECT p.name AS project_name, c.name AS client_name, c.email FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.client_id JOIN invoices i ON p.project_id = i.project_id WHERE i.status != 'paid';
